description: Dark ripples run along a serene white and blue lake. Dark blue hills stand above the lake, along with a bluish green sky. Another strip of blue runs along the line where the water and hills meet, then arches upwards towards the sky on the righthand side of the page.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
